name: Rico (Rigid)
description:
A lean, sinewy man in his late thirties with a rigid spine that never seems to relax, shoulders pulled back in a posture of perpetual readiness. His face is angular and austere, with a sharp jawline and hooded eyes that hold an impenetrable, almost suspicious expression—the corners of his mouth barely moving, locked in a thin line of controlled reserve. His arms rest unnaturally close to his torso, fingers slightly curled inward as though guarding something invisible; even at rest, every muscle appears tensed, contained, waiting.

T-pose, humanoid, game character, realistic proportions.
